name: Cebreros (Spain)
description: Square flag quartered red and white, charged at the centre with a light blue disc bearing the crowned municipal arms of Cebreros (a zebra on blue) between four white vine leaves.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 28 October 1993 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 243 of 21 December 1993); the flag is quartered in cross, 1 and 4 red and 2 and 3 white, framed in a sky blue circle with four white vine leaves, one in each corner, charged at the centre with the municipal arms.

features.role: disc with the arms and four vine leaves
